CustomField.description: Non Production Calculated Overage Rate based to allow for multiple services
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL( TSGCFG__Consolidation_Method__c, 'Average') && TSGCFG__TotalCPCColorLineItems__c> 0 , TSGCFG__SumofCPCOverageColor__c/ TSGCFG__TotalCPCColorLineItems__c, IF(TSGCFG__TotalColorVolume__c<>0, (TSGCFG__TotalColorOveragePrice__c + TSGCFG__TotalColorOveragePriceVolumeIncludes__c)/ TSGCFG__TotalColorVolume__c, If(TSGCFG__TotalCPCColorLineItems__c > 0, TSGCFG__SumofCPCOverageColor__c/ TSGCFG__TotalCPCColorLineItems__c, 0)))
CustomField.label: Color Overage Rate
